DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最後にその傘を見たのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: When did you last see that umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日です。なくしたと思って来ましたが、友人へ貸したことも思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失と貸出の両可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday. I came because I thought I had lost it, but I also remembered lending it to a friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain both possibilities: losing it and having lent it out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸した後に返ってきたか、分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know whether it was returned after you lent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。自分で落とした場所は分からないので、駅で落としたと書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却未確認と紛失場所不明を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked yet. I do not know where I might have dropped it, so please do not write that I lost it at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that return is unconfirmed and the loss location is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる経過から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the sequence of events you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ連絡すると、持っていると返事がありました。紛失した事実は確認できませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人が所持と返答したことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I contacted my friend, and they replied that they have it. I could not confirm that it was actually lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that your friend replied that they have it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その返事と現在の状況を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us organize that reply and the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返す日時はまだ決まっていませんが、持っていることは本人から聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所持情報と返却日未定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have not decided when they will return it, but I heard from them directly that they have it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the possession information from the undecided return date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の届出の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how to handle this report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。落としたという説明を訂正し、返却の相談は自分と友人で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紛失申告を訂正し友人と返却を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will correct my explanation that I dropped it and discuss its return directly with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the loss report and discuss return with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で確認します。推測の紛失場所は記録しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check on that basis. We will not record a guessed loss location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達についての確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check about redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が明日家にいると言いました。それで明日届けてもらえると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族在宅で再配達されると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family said they will be home tomorrow. So I expect it can be delivered tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you assumed redelivery would happen because your family will be home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 在宅の予定と再配達の依頼は別です。申込みの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Plans to be at home and a redelivery request are separate. Do you have a record of requesting it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ申し込んでいません。家族の返事だけで手配したことにはなりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未申込と在宅連絡との差を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not requested it yet. My family's reply alone does not mean it has been arranged, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you have not applied and that a message about being home is different. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号で現在の状態と方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will use the number to check the current status and methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この票です。家族が空いている時間も、配達枠と同じとは限らないので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 票番号で状態と選択時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the notice. My family's available hours may not match the delivery slots, so I would like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the notice number to check the status and available times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 選べる時間を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain which times can be selected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族には確定と伝えず、選べる枠を見てもう一度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ未確定と伝え選べる枠で再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not tell my family it is confirmed; I will look at the available slots and discuss it with them again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family it is unconfirmed and discuss again using the available slots. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件が分かった後に依頼できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can make the request once you know the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。荷物の状態と時間枠を確認し、家族の了承を得てから申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件と家族了承後に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the parcel status and time slots and apply after my family agrees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make the request after checking the conditions and getting family agreement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この番号で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check using this number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくしたカードについて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me about the card you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行カードです。クレジットカードは残っているので、そちらで同じ口座を操作できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別カードで紛失銀行カードを代用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my bank card. I still have my credit card, so can I use that to access the same account?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether another card can replace the lost bank card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別のカードを代わりに使えるとは判断しないでください。カードの種類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not assume another card can be used instead. We will check what types of cards they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いに使えるカードなら同じと思っていました。口座のカードが見当たらないことを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カードの役割の誤解を直し紛失対象を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought any card used for payment was the same. I want to ask about my account card being missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding of the cards' roles and identify the missing card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届出と本人確認の方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the reporting and identity verification methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っているカードの番号を、なくしたカードの番号として書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別カード番号を紛失カード番号にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not write the number of the card I still have as the number of the lost card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use another card's number as the lost card number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない項目は分からないと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For anything you do not know, please say that you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。最後に口座のカードを見た場所と時点を説明し、番号は推測しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後の確認時点場所を述べ不明番号を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will explain where and when I last saw the account card and will not guess its number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the place and time you last checked it and do not guess an unknown number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認を行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will make the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚の役割を分けて、なくしたカードの届出と今後の手順を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 役割を分け届出と次の手順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish the two cards' roles and ask about reporting the lost card and the next steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the roles and ask about the report and next steps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that information to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のどこが気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What concerns you about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ふたの外側に粉があります。中身が悪くなったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外粉を中身異常と思った疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is powder on the outside of the lid. I thought the contents had gone bad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern that powder on the outside meant something was wrong inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側の状態だけでは中身の原因は分かりません。開けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The outside condition alone does not tell us the cause inside. Have you opened it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。外に粉があるという観察と、中身への推測を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と観察推測の区別を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will distinguish my observation that there is powder outside from my guess about the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it is unopened and distinguish observation from speculation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入後の持ち運びや保管を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us how you carried and stored it after purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 粉物と同じ袋で持ち帰りました。そちらから付いたかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同袋の粉物と付着原因不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought it home in the same bag as a powdered product. I do not know whether it came from that either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the powdered item in the same bag and that the cause of the residue is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品と購入記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the product and purchase record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自己判断で洗って跡を消さず、この状態の写真と記録を示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 痕跡を洗い消さず写真と記録を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to wash away the evidence on my own; I would like to show a photo of this condition and the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not wash away the traces; show the photo and record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応は状態を確認してから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the response after checking the condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。中身が腐敗したと断言せず、外側の粉と持ち帰り状況を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 断定せず状態確認を担当に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not insist that the contents have spoiled; I will explain the powder outside and how I brought it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member to check the condition without asserting a cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当が確認します。開封せずそのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the staff member will check it. Please leave it unopened and wait with it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの道をお考えですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三百メートルとあるので、ここから池まですぐだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 距離表示を現在地からの距離と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says three hundred meters, so I thought the pond would be very close from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your assumption that the distance sign measures from your current location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その距離の始点を図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check on the map where that distance starts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この別の入口からの表示でした。自分の現在地からの距離とは違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示始点が別入口と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was measured from this other entrance. It was not the distance from where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the displayed starting point is another entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在地の印はこちらです。戻る場所も同じ入口ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the current-location marker. Are you returning to the same entrance too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今いる入口へ戻りたいです。片道表示だけで往復が三百メートルとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰着入口と往復距離を片道から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to return to the entrance where I am now. I will not assume the round trip is three hundred meters based only on a one-way sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the return entrance and round-trip distance from the one-way distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 経路と休憩場所を合わせて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look at the route together with places to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 長く歩く余裕がないので、池へ行く前に近い休憩場所を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行余裕に合わせ近い休憩先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not have time for a long walk, so I would like to choose a nearby rest spot before going to the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a nearby rest spot suited to how much walking you can manage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この経路の案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the guidance for this route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。現在地と帰る入口で経路を確認し、今日は近くで休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地帰着点を照合し近場休憩を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check the route using my current location and return entrance, and rest nearby today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match your current location and return point and choose a nearby rest spot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内された休憩場所へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the rest spot you have been shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券のどの部分を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the ticket would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここに三つの駅があります。全部で降りて改札を通る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 経由三駅で全て降りる必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are three stations here. Do I have to get off and go through the ticket gates at all of them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you must get off at all three stations listed on the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経由の表示と途中で降りる予定は別です。ご希望の行程を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The route information and plans to stop off are separate. Please tell us your intended itinerary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最終の駅へ行きたいだけです。経由欄を訪問先の一覧と読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終駅だけが目的と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only want to go to the final station. I read the route field as a list of places to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only the final station is your destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券と利用列車の条件を係が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the ticket and train conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で外へ出る予定はありません。乗換えが必要かを、経由駅の数だけで決めず聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中外出なしと実際の乗換え確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not plan to go outside at intermediate stations. I would like to ask whether transfers are needed rather than deciding just from the number of stations in the route field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you do not plan to exit partway and ask about actual transfers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際の乗換えは当日の経路案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check actual transfers using today's route information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 券の経由欄を自分で消さず、そのまま係へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経由表示を消さず券を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the ticket to the staff member as it is without erasing the route field myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket without erasing the route information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目的地と出発地も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us your destination and departure station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二駅です。券の経由と実際の乗換えを分けて案内してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発着二駅を示し経由と乗換えを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: These two stations. I would like separate explanations of the ticket's route and the actual transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the departure and arrival stations and distinguish the route from transfers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お持ちの券に合う行程を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check an itinerary that matches your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停止とあるので、私の申請が止められたと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止見出しを申請停止と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says suspended, so I thought my application had been stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the suspension heading meant your application was suspended. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見出しだけでご本人の申請状態とは判断できません。本文を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You cannot determine your own application status from the heading alone. Let us check the body text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本文には受付システムの停止時間とあります。自分の申請の決定通知ではなかったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本文がシステム案内と読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The body says the reception system will be suspended during certain hours. So it was not a decision notice about my application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reread the body as a system announcement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申請の状態は別に照会が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your application status requires a separate inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日申し込んだ件の状態も知りたいです。システムの停止時間だけで却下と家族へ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請却下を断定せず個別状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also want to know the status of what I applied for yesterday. I will not tell my family it was rejected based only on the system downtime.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not conclude rejection; ask about your individual application status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付記録をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a record of acceptance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号の控えがあります。通知の日付と自分の受付日も分けて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えと通知の別日付を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy with the number. I will also show the notice date separately from my own application date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the record and the separate dates of the notice and application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象を区別して担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us distinguish the subjects and check with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。一般の停止案内と、自分の受付状態を別々に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一般通知と本人照会を分け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check the general suspension announcement separately from my own application status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the general notice separately from your individual inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では本文と受付記録を一緒にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please show us the body text together with your acceptance record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check your appointment record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の医院でこの病院を教えてもらいました。予約も入っていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介病院名で予約もあると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The previous clinic told me about this hospital. I think an appointment has also been made.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you assumed being given the referral hospital's name meant you also had an appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紹介先の案内と予約は別です。予約日時の通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Information about a referral destination and an appointment are separate. Do you have a notice of the appointment date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 病院名のメモだけです。日時は聞いていないので、確定した予約とは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時通知なしと予約未確認を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a note with the hospital name. I have not been told a date or time, so I cannot say I have a confirmed appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that there is no date-time notice and the appointment is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付方法を担当が確認します。紹介の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check how you can register. Do you have referral documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒を持っています。メモと紹介書類を別に見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモと紹介封筒を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an envelope. I would like to show the note separately from the referral documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the note and referral envelope separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の扱いも案内します。自己判断で開封せずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also explain how to handle the documents. Please wait without opening the envelope on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このまま渡します。今日必ず診察できると決めず、初診の条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を自己開封せず当日診察条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hand it over as it is. I will not assume I can definitely be seen today; I want to ask about the conditions for an initial visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not open the envelope yourself; ask about the conditions for being seen that day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。病院の紹介と予約を分け、書類と受付方法を確認して次の行動を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紹介予約受付を分け次の行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish being referred to the hospital from having an appointment, check the documents and registration method, and decide what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish referral, appointment, and registration and decide the next step. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、初診担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you with the first-visit staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った場所を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell us where you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベンチの下です。持ち主を探すため鍵の細かい刻印をネットへ載せようとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得場所と細部公開予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Under a bench. I was going to post the key's detailed engraving online to find its owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the discovery location and your plan to publish the details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ公開していませんか。特徴は届出で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not published it yet? We will check the identifying details as part of the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真は撮りましたが未投稿です。細部を誰にでも見せる前に届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真未投稿と現物届出を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took a photo, but have not posted it. I will report it before showing the details to everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the photo is unposted and you will hand in the actual item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現物を確認します。ご自身の鍵とは分けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the actual item. Have you kept it separate from your own keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の袋に入れました。自分の家の鍵と一緒に写っていないか、写真も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自他の鍵を分け写真の映込みも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put it in a separate bag. I will also review the photo to check that my own house key is not in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate your key from the other person's and check the photo for accidental inclusion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画像の扱いはご自身で確認してください。持ち主の照合は担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check how to handle the image yourself. The staff member will verify the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 刻印を手掛かりに私が持ち主と断定して渡すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で所有者認定して手渡ししない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not decide who the owner is myself using the engraving and hand it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not identify an owner yourself and hand the key directly to them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った時点と場所を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record when and where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらへ現物を渡します。時間と場所を伝え、写真を公開して独自に渡す予定はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻場所と現物を届け公開捜索をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give you the actual key here. I will tell you the time and place and abandon my plan to publish the photo and hand it over independently.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the time and place, hand in the item, and stop the public search. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it with that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居する方はこちらの全員ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今同じ家なので全員書きましたが、引越すのは私だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居全員記入だが転居は自分だけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote everyone down because we live together now, but only I am moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you listed everyone living together but only you are moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同居している方と、転居する方を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish people living together from people who are moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母の郵便まで新住所へ来るようにはしたくありません。対象の記入を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母を対象にしたくないと訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not want even my mother's mail to come to the new address. I want to correct who is covered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a correction so your mother is not included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法を担当が案内します。旧住所にもご家族は残るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will explain how to correct it. Your family will remain at the old address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。旧住所がなくなるわけではないので、母の住所を変更済みと説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所に母が残ると明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The old address is not disappearing, so I will not say my mother's address has been changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that your mother remains at the old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届の内容と受付条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the notification details and acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の名前だけが対象になるか読み返します。家族の了解だけで全部転送できるとも考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象氏名を読み直し全家族転送を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will reread it to see whether only my name is covered. I also will not assume family agreement alone lets me forward everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reread the covered names and do not assume forwarding for the entire family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が手順を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。引越す本人と残る家族を分け、対象を確認してから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転居者と残留者を分け提出前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish myself as the person moving from family staying behind and check who is covered before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate those moving from those remaining and check before submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で確認します。まだ受付は進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check on that basis. We will not proceed with acceptance yet.
